$comment: Cross-references in apidoc source that name something which does not exist.
Each is a bug in the source repo, not in docgen. They are listed here so the
compile fails on NEW breakage while these stay visible; delete an entry as soon
as the upstream fix lands, and docgen will tell you when one is no longer hit.
Keyed by source repo: an entry only applies to, and is only reported stale by,
a compile of that repo. Without that, compiling any module would report every one of another repo's
entries as no-longer-occurring, which reads as 'upstream fixed everything'.
A module's entries cover references into the SDK too: those are checked against
the compiled SDK index it is told to resolve against, so a module naming a type
or member the SDK does not have fails the same way one of its own does.
Run docgen with --strict to compile as if this file were empty.
References broken only in published releases, which are immutable and
therefore cannot be fixed upstream. Allowed like `refs`, but never
reported stale: an entry here describes a frozen past and will stop
occurring the moment the affected releases age out of what we compile,
which is not the same as upstream having fixed anything.
The 23 SDK entries moved here in Sep 2026 were fixed upstream by tidev/titanium-sdk#14569. They stay because every published GA still carries them and a tag cannot be rewritten.

tidev/titanium-sdk.Global.Intl.NumberFormat.NumberFormatOpt: declared as the top-level pseudo-type NumberFormatOptions, not nested under NumberFormat. Fixed on main by #14569; still broken in every GA up to 13.4.1.
as above. Fixed on main by #14569; still broken in every GA up to 13.4.1.
